If you're interested in how geoms are used within a repo you can use this function

```{r}
library("tidyverse")
library("ggplot2wrapped")

data_cararthompson_tidytuesday <- get_tidytuesday_repo_geom_usage(repo_owner = "cararthompson", repo_name = "tidytuesdays")
```

```{r}
data_cararthompson_tidytuesday |> 
  make_geom_interactive_upset_chart(min_geom_appearances = 1, min_interaction_size = 1)
```
